matrix.check_goal: Verify that key PT9L design-input parameters are carried into design outputs and validation conditions consistently.
Verify that risk items, risk controls, and verification activities form a closed traceability chain.
Verify that software requirements, design, test records, validation, and traceability records are consistent.
Verify consistency across BOM, process, inspection, packaging, labels, drawings, and transfer records.
Verify controlled status, version history, review signatures, and document-control completeness across all stages.
